title: Damage Enchantments
description: Adds some more damage type enchantments
body:
This pack adds several enchantments which increase damage against specific enemies.

The added enchantments are:
Illager's Bane:
  Based on Minecraft Dungeons. This enchant increases damage dealt to Illager-aligned enemies.
Genesis:
  Increases damage dealt to end-themed enemies.
Bacon Butcherer:
  Increases damage dealt to pigkind. Yes this can actually be useful. (works on piglins and hoglins)
Unchanting:
  Based on Minecraft Dungeons. Increases damage dealt to enemies wearing enchanted armor.

All enchantments go up to level V.
